content.text: I've finished reading the contracts. Now writing the miner-core package, starting with hashing, the catalogue and the signer.

input.command:
mkdir -p /c/Users/shrey/Desktop/AIRcoin/miner-core/{minerd,simulator,controller,mock,deploy,docs,config,tests} && cd /c/Users/shrey/Desktop/AIRcoin/miner-core && touch simulator/__init__.py controller/__init__.py mock/__init__.py && cat > requirements.txt <<'EOF'
eth-account>=0.13
rfc8785>=0.1.4
paho-mqtt>=2.0
httpx>=0.27
fastapi>=0.110
uvicorn>=0.29
psutil>=5.9
jsonschema>=4.18
pytest>=8
# optional, only for a serial GPS module without gpsd:
# pyserial>=3.5
# pynmea2>=1.19
EOF
cat > pyproject.toml <<'EOF'
[project]
name = "aircoin-miner-core"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "AIRcoin Workstream B: miner daemon, PoUW estimator, signer and uplink"
requires-python = ">=3.11"

[tool.setuptools]
packages = ["minerd", "simulator", "controller", "mock"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["."]
EOF
cat > .gitignore <<'EOF'
__pycache__/
*.pyc
.env
var/
*.sqlite
out/
EOF
cat > .env.example <<'EOF'
# Copy to miner-core/.env (or export the variables). All are optional for the local demo.
MINER_ID=miner-001
# Device key. If unset, minerd uses var/device-key.hex, then the demo key in
# chain-market/contracts/seed-data.json (what the local validator expects).
# MINER_PRIVATE_KEY=0x...
MQTT_HOST=localhost
MQTT_PORT=1883
VALIDATOR_URL=http://localhost:3001
CONTROLLER_PORT=8090
SCENARIO=clean_morning
# none | gpsd | serial:/dev/ttyAMA0
GPS_SOURCE=gpsd
# mqtt (real C1 from vision-twin) | mock (built-in 20-plant simulator)
VISION_SOURCE=mqtt
EOF
